Subject: Post-discovery recap & next steps — technical deep dive

Hi Jane / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Goal for the next meeting: 45–60 minute technical deep dive focused on latency, SSO, and data isolation for your pilot.
2) Suggested attendees: your infra lead + security reviewer + procurement contact + our platform/security/solutions engineers.
3) Timeline: ideally run the deep dive next week (see proposed time slots attached).

Action items for your side: please confirm which of the proposed slots works and share the security contact we should loop in. Also any required evidence we should prepare ahead of time (SOC2, data-retention policy, IP/contract constraints). I attached a draft SOW and a current SOC2 attestation to speed the procurement thread.

Proposed next steps on our side: I’ll loop in Marissa (security), David (procurement enablement) and Karthik (platform) once you confirm attendees/times so we can coordinate internal availability and bring the right artifacts.

Thanks — look forward to locking this.

— Evelyn
